# Gitlytics Agent Plugin & Skills ### Official MCP Server Config, Agent Skills (`npx skills`), and Antigravity Plugin for Gitlytics

Connect **Antigravity**, **Claude Code**, **Cursor**, **Windsurf**, **Codex**, and **OpenCode** to Gitlytics' GitHub traffic analytics, star history, AI health scorecards, and 50-theme dynamic SVG README widgets.
--- ## Quick Start ### 1. Install Agent Skills via Vercel CLI (`skills.sh`) Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and Antigravity: ```bash npx skills add ameyachopade/gitlytics-plugin -g ``` Install an individual skill: ```bash npx skills add ameyachopade/gitlytics-plugin@gitlytics-widgets -g npx skills add ameyachopade/gitlytics-plugin@gitlytics-badges -g npx skills add ameyachopade/gitlytics-plugin@gitlytics-analytics -g npx skills add ameyachopade/gitlytics-plugin@gitlytics-automation -g ``` ### 2. Connect the Hosted Cloud MCP Server (Zero Python / Zero Key Required) Choose the endpoint that matches your workflow: * **1-Click OAuth 2.1 Sign-In (All 9 tools - public + private workspace):** `https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp-oauth` * **Zero-Login Public Mode (5 public widget, badge, logo, profile & star-history tools immediately):** `https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp` * **Headless / CI Fallback:** `https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp` with a scoped `glt_live_...` API key from [dashboard.gitlytics.dev/integrations](https://dashboard.gitlytics.dev/integrations). **Antigravity / Cursor / Windsurf / VS Code / OpenCode (`mcp_config.json` / `mcp.json` - 1-Click OAuth 2.1 Sign-In):** ```json { "mcpServers": { "gitlytics": { "type": "http", "url": "https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp-oauth" } } } ``` **Public Widgets & Badges Only (Zero Login Required):** ```json { "mcpServers": { "gitlytics": { "type": "http", "url": "https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp" } } } ``` **CLI Agents (Claude Code / Codex):** ```bash # Claude Code - 1-click OAuth 2.1 sign-in (all 9 tools) claude mcp add --transport http gitlytics https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp-oauth # Claude Code - zero-login public tools only claude mcp add --transport http gitlytics https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp # Codex - 1-click OAuth 2.1 sign-in codex mcp add gitlytics --url https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp-oauth ``` **Headless / CI API Key Fallback:** Pass `Authorization: Bearer ${GITLYTICS_API_KEY}` in your client's `headers` on `https://api.gitlytics.dev/mcp` (or `--header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITLYTICS_API_KEY}"` in Claude Code). ### 3. Optional Local/Offline Stdio Mode (`gitlytics[mcp]`) For privacy-first users querying local `traffic_*.csv` archives without touching Gitlytics Cloud: ```bash pip install "gitlytics[mcp]" export GITLYTICS_TOKEN="your_github_token_in_env" gitlytics mcp --data-dir ./data ``` See [mcp_config.local.json](mcp_config.local.json) for the local stdio configuration template. --- ## Exposed MCP Tools ### Public Tools (No API Key Needed) | Tool | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | `list_widget_catalog` | Lists all 50 profile cards, 50 themes, 20 visual variants, shapes, and tech logo totals. | | `search_tech_logos` | Searches the 200 verified tech logo slugs by keyword or category. | | `build_widget_embed` | Validates parameters and generates SVG URLs, Markdown, HTML, and light/dark `` embeds. | | `get_public_github_profile` | Fetches cached public GitHub user stats and top public repositories. | | `get_public_star_history` | Returns cached cumulative star history and next star milestone projection. | ### Authenticated Cloud Tools (`glt_live_...` Scoped API Key) | Tool | Required Scope | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `list_connected_repos` | `read:traffic` | Lists repositories connected to your Gitlytics Cloud workspace. | | `get_repo_traffic` | `read:traffic` | Queries archived views, unique visitors, clones, referrers, and top paths (up to 365 days). | | `get_ai_health_analysis` | `read:analysis` | Reads cached AI health scorecards, key areas, dev focus, and recommendations. | | `trigger_repo_refresh` | `write:refresh` | Triggers a cooldown-bounded on-demand traffic sync from GitHub. | ### MCP Resources * `gitlytics://catalog/widgets` - Complete JSON catalog of cards, variants, and shapes. * `gitlytics://catalog/themes` - Complete JSON catalog of all 50 unified themes. --- ## Included Skills (4) | Skill | Focus | | :--- | :--- | | [`gitlytics-widgets`](skills/gitlytics-widgets/SKILL.md) | GitHub profile README cards (50 cards), 50 unified themes, 20 visual variants, charts, and light/dark `` layouts. | | [`gitlytics-badges`](skills/gitlytics-badges/SKILL.md) | Tech-stack logo capsules (200 verified icons), custom concept badges, live views/clones/stars badges, and PyPI version badges. | | [`gitlytics-analytics`](skills/gitlytics-analytics/SKILL.md) | Traffic anomaly diagnostics, clone-to-visitor conversion analysis, star projections, and AI health scorecards. | | [`gitlytics-automation`](skills/gitlytics-automation/SKILL.md) | Defeating GitHub's 14-day traffic limit via GitHub Actions, local `gitlytics sync` cron jobs, and safe self-hosted dashboards. | --- ## Repository Structure ```text gitlytics-plugin/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── mcp_config.json # Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP config ├── mcp_config.local.json # Optional local stdio MCP template ├── rules/AGENTS.md # Always-on agent guardrails ├── assets/logo.png # Plugin icon ├── skills/ │ ├── gitlytics-widgets/ # SKILL.md + references + evals │ ├── gitlytics-badges/ # SKILL.md + references + evals │ ├── gitlytics-analytics/ # SKILL.md + references + evals │ └── gitlytics-automation/ # SKILL.md + references + evals ├── scripts/validate_plugin.py # Offline schema & lint validator ├── SECURITY.md ├── CONTRIBUTING.md └── LICENSE ``` ## Validation ```bash python scripts/validate_plugin.py ``` --- ## 🔗 The Gitlytics Ecosystem | Project | Role | Link | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **[gitlytics](https://github.com/ameyachopade/gitlytics)** | Core Python library, CLI (`fetch`, `sync`, `stars`, `dashboard`, `mcp`), and self-hosted local dashboard | [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/gitlytics/) | | **[gitlytics-npm](https://github.com/ameyachopade/gitlytics-npm)** | Zero-dependency Node.js CLI, JS/TS SDK, dual-mode MCP & local dashboard | [npm (`@gitlytics/cli`)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gitlytics/cli) | | **[gitlytics-plugin](https://github.com/ameyachopade/gitlytics-plugin)** *(this repo)* | Official Antigravity plugin, MCP configs & 4 Vercel Agent Skills | [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/ameyachopade/gitlytics-plugin) | | **[gitlytics-github-traffic-automation](https://github.com/ameyachopade/gitlytics-github-traffic-automation)** | Composite GitHub Action for automated CSV traffic backups | [GitHub Action](https://github.com/ameyachopade/gitlytics-github-traffic-automation) | | **Gitlytics Web & Docs** | Official Homepage, Docs Hub & Engineering Blog | [gitlytics.dev](https://gitlytics.dev) / [docs.gitlytics.dev](https://docs.gitlytics.dev) / [blog.gitlytics.dev](https://blog.gitlytics.dev) | | **Gitlytics Cloud Dashboard** | Hosted Analytics Dashboard, Embed Studio & MCP OAuth Consent UI | [dashboard.gitlytics.dev](https://dashboard.gitlytics.dev) | | **Gitlytics Hosted API & MCP** | 50-card / 200-logo SVG engine & Streamable HTTP MCP server (`/mcp-oauth` & `/mcp`) | [api.gitlytics.dev](https://api.gitlytics.dev) | --- ## 🤝 Contributing, Security & License - **Contributing**: See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) for skill guidelines and validator checks. - **Security**: See [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) for credential safety and private vulnerability reporting. - **License**: Licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).
